sources.cite: Google Cloud, Professional Cloud Architect exam guide v6.1 (English exams on or after October 30): Section 1 Designing and planning a cloud solution architecture (~25%), Section 2 (~18%), Section 3 Designing for security and compliance (~19%), Section 4 (~15%), Section 5 (~11%), Section 6 (~12%)

The v6.1 weights differ slightly from the course seed's (17.5/17.5/15/12.5/12.5); the objective wording is the course seed's. Finding for the verification pass. sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Connectivity Tests: Reasons for dropped test packets
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: 'Dropped due to a firewall rule': a test packet can be denied by a blocking VPC firewall rule or firewall policy rule; a higher-priority deny is a possible cause; the result is a configuration analysis ('the actual data plane might allow the packet through due to connection tracking'). The evaluation order page (read 2026-11-18): Cloud NGFW 'always evaluates rules in hierarchical firewall policies and regional system firewall policies before it evaluates any other firewall rules'; goto_next passes evaluation to the next policy or step. The Connectivity Tests result's naming of the policy and priority is an authored rendering.
